asr.full_text: This is Shah and right now AVAX is trading around $9.10 and the structure is unfolding almost exactly how we mapped it in the last update previously we identified a clear double bottom formation sitting on the support around $8.22 cent, that level acted as a strong base and the second touch confirmed that buyers were stepping in again we also marked the neckline of the top double bottom at around $9.80. The plan was simple… Hold support then push toward the neckline for a possible breakout. Price did exactly that… Avax respected the $8.22 support and bounced strongly to start moving upward toward the neckline. Right now, Price is sitting in the middle of the range between support and neckline. It has not yet reached $9.80, but the structure still favors the upside. Why? Because the double bottom remains valid as long as the support is not broken. The higher reaction from the second bottom shows demand is present even though price pause before touching the neckline momentum has not completely faded consolidation in the middle of the range often builds pressure before the next leg the key confirmation comes only after breakout. For the bullish case to fully activate, AVAX needs to break above the $9.80 neckline with strength. At the same time, there is a visible downtrend line acting as dynamic resistance. A clean breakout above both the neckline and the downtrend line would shift the structure clearly bullish. Once that happens, the next major target sits around $11.4. And that is the original resistance zone from previous price action and becomes the natural magnet if breakout confirms. Until then we are still in the buildup phase. As long as $8.22 holds bulls remain in control of the structure. A drop below that level with strong daily closes would invalidate the double bottom and weaken the bullish scenario but currently price is holding above support and slowly compressing under resistance. This kind of setup is classic, strong base, push toward neckline, short consolidation, then breakout attempt. The more times resistance gets approached, the weaker it tends to become. So the roadmap is clear.
